t: 第一次世界大战:日本向德宣战.
te: Japan declares war on Germany.
dz: 第一次世界大战:日本向德宣战.
de: World War I: Japan declares war on Germany.

t: 英国远征军和法国第五集团军在德国军队面前开始大撤退。
te: The British Expeditionary Force and the French Fifth Army begin their Great Retreat before the German Army.
dz: 第一次世界大战：英国远征军和法国第五集团军在德国军队面前开始大撤退。
de: World War I: The British Expeditionary Force and the French Fifth Army begin their Great Retreat before the German Army.

t: 塞尔之战以第一次盟军在战争中取胜而告终.
te: The Battle of Cer ends as the first Allied victory in the war.
dz: 第一次世界大战:塞尔之战以第一次盟军在战争中取胜而告终.
de: World War I: The Battle of Cer ends as the first Allied victory in the war.

t: 第一次世界大战：德军占领那慕尔。
te: German troops capture Namur.
dz: 第一次世界大战：德军占领那慕尔。
de: World War I: German troops capture Namur.

t: 第一次世界大战：日本向奥匈帝国宣战。
te: Japan declares war on Austria-Hungary.
dz: 第一次世界大战：日本向奥匈帝国宣战。
de: World War I: Japan declares war on Austria-Hungary.

t: 天主教鲁汶大学图书馆被德军故意摧毁. 数十万本不可替代的卷和哥特和文艺复兴时期的手稿被丢失.
te: The library of the Catholic University of Leuven is deliberately destroyed by the German Army. Hundreds of thousands of…
dz: 一战:天主教鲁汶大学图书馆被德军故意摧毁. 数十万本不可替代的卷和哥特和文艺复兴时期的手稿被丢失.
de: World War I: The library of the Catholic University of Leuven is deliberately destroyed by the German Army. Hundreds of thousands of irreplaceable volumes and Gothic and Renaissance manuscripts are lost.

t: 德国殖民地多哥兰经过 20 天的战役后向法国和英国军队投降。多哥兰是第一次世界大战中第一个落入…
te: The German colony of Togoland surrenders to French and British forces after a 20-day campaign. Togoland is the first Ge…
dz: 第一次世界大战：德国殖民地多哥兰经过 20 天的战役后向法国和英国军队投降。多哥兰是第一次世界大战中第一个落入盟军手中的德国殖民地。
de: World War I: The German colony of Togoland surrenders to French and British forces after a 20-day campaign. Togoland is the first German colony to fall to Allied hands in World War I.

t: 在从蒙斯撤退期间,由霍拉斯·史密斯-多里安爵士将军所指挥的英国第二军团在勒克托(Le Cate…
te: During the retreat from Mons, the British II Corps commanded by General Sir Horace Smith-Dorrien fights a vigorous and …
dz: 第一次世界大战:在从蒙斯撤退期间,由霍拉斯·史密斯-多里安爵士将军所指挥的英国第二军团在勒克托(Le Cateau)进行了一场激烈而成功的防御行动.
de: World War I: During the retreat from Mons, the British II Corps commanded by General Sir Horace Smith-Dorrien fights a vigorous and successful defensive action at Le Cateau.

t: 埃特勒战役：大撤退期间皇家明斯特燧发枪团的英国后卫行动。
te: Battle of Étreux: A British rearguard action by the Royal Munster Fusiliers during the Great Retreat.
dz: 第一次世界大战：埃特勒战役：大撤退期间皇家明斯特燧发枪团的英国后卫行动。
de: World War I: Battle of Étreux: A British rearguard action by the Royal Munster Fusiliers during the Great Retreat.

t: 围攻青岛:由副将佐道克奇·加藤所指挥的一支日本舰队沿德军青岛全海岸线实施封锁,发起围攻青岛.
te: Siege of Tsingtao: A Japanese fleet commanded by Vice Admiral Sadakichi Kato imposes a blockade along the whole coastli…
dz: 第一次世界大战:围攻青岛:由副将佐道克奇·加藤所指挥的一支日本舰队沿德军青岛全海岸线实施封锁,发起围攻青岛.
de: World War I: Siege of Tsingtao: A Japanese fleet commanded by Vice Admiral Sadakichi Kato imposes a blockade along the whole coastline of German Tsingtao, initiating the Siege of Tsingtao.

t: 英国皇家海军在黑尔戈兰湾海战中击败德国舰队。
te: The Royal Navy defeats the German fleet in the Battle of Heligoland Bight.
dz: 第一次世界大战：英国皇家海军在黑尔戈兰湾海战中击败德国舰队。
de: World War I: The Royal Navy defeats the German fleet in the Battle of Heligoland Bight.

t: 圣康坦战役开始，法国第五集团军在埃纳省圣康坦反击入侵的德国人。
te: Start of the Battle of St. Quentin in which the French Fifth Army counter-attacked the invading Germans at Saint-Quenti…
dz: 第一次世界大战：圣康坦战役开始，法国第五集团军在埃纳省圣康坦反击入侵的德国人。
de: World War I: Start of the Battle of St. Quentin in which the French Fifth Army counter-attacked the invading Germans at Saint-Quentin, Aisne.

t: 德国人在坦能堡战役中击败俄罗斯人。
te: Germans defeat the Russians in the Battle of Tannenberg.
dz: 第一次世界大战：德国人在坦能堡战役中击败俄罗斯人。
de: World War I: Germans defeat the Russians in the Battle of Tannenberg.

t: 威廉,阿尔巴尼亚王子,由于反对他的统治,在仅仅6个月后离开该国.
te: Wilhelm, Prince of Albania leaves the country after just six months due to opposition to his rule.
dz: 威廉,阿尔巴尼亚王子,由于反对他的统治,在仅仅6个月后离开该国.
de: Wilhelm, Prince of Albania leaves the country after just six months due to opposition to his rule.

t: 大库罗内战役开始，德军对南锡市附近高地上的法军阵地发起进攻。
te: Start of the Battle of Grand Couronné, a German assault against French positions on high ground near the city of Nancy.
dz: 第一次世界大战：大库罗内战役开始，德军对南锡市附近高地上的法军阵地发起进攻。
de: World War I: Start of the Battle of Grand Couronné, a German assault against French positions on high ground near the city of Nancy.

t: 法国作曲家阿尔贝里克·马格纳德被击毙,为他的地产抵御入侵的德军士兵.
te: French composer Albéric Magnard is killed defending his estate against invading German soldiers.
dz: 法国作曲家阿尔贝里克·马格纳德被击毙,为他的地产抵御入侵的德军士兵.
de: French composer Albéric Magnard is killed defending his estate against invading German soldiers.

t: 第一次马恩河战役开始。在巴黎东北部，法军进攻并击败了向首都挺进的德军。
te: First Battle of the Marne begins. Northeast of Paris, the French attack and defeat German forces who are advancing on t…
dz: 第一次世界大战：第一次马恩河战役开始。在巴黎东北部，法军进攻并击败了向首都挺进的德军。
de: World War I: First Battle of the Marne begins. Northeast of Paris, the French attack and defeat German forces who are advancing on the capital.

t: 第一次马恩河战役开始，这场战役将阻止德意志帝国军队向法国推进。
te: The First Battle of the Marne, which would halt the Imperial German Army's advance into France, begins.
dz: 第一次世界大战：第一次马恩河战役开始，这场战役将阻止德意志帝国军队向法国推进。
de: World War I: The First Battle of the Marne, which would halt the Imperial German Army's advance into France, begins.

t: 二等兵托马斯·海格特成为第一位在战争期间因逃兵而被处决的英国士兵。
te: Private Thomas Highgate becomes the first British soldier to be executed for desertion during the war.
dz: 第一次世界大战：二等兵托马斯·海格特成为第一位在战争期间因逃兵而被处决的英国士兵。
de: World War I: Private Thomas Highgate becomes the first British soldier to be executed for desertion during the war.

t: 加拿大汽车机枪旅的创建，英国陆军第一个全机械化部队。
te: The creation of the Canadian Automobile Machine Gun Brigade, the first fully mechanized unit in the British Army.
dz: 第一次世界大战：加拿大汽车机枪旅的创建，英国陆军第一个全机械化部队。
de: World War I: The creation of the Canadian Automobile Machine Gun Brigade, the first fully mechanized unit in the British Army.

t: 芬兰学校的俄语和俄语历史教学,作为沙皇尼古拉二世在芬兰实施的强制俄罗斯化计划的一部分,被责令大…
te: The teaching of the Russian language and Russian history in Finnish schools is ordered to be considerably increased as …
dz: 第二次俄罗斯化时期: 芬兰学校的俄语和俄语历史教学,作为沙皇尼古拉二世在芬兰实施的强制俄罗斯化计划的一部分,被责令大幅增加.
de: The Second Period of Russification: The teaching of the Russian language and Russian history in Finnish schools is ordered to be considerably increased as part of the forced Russification program in Finland run by Tsar Nicholas II.

t: 澳大利亚入侵德属新几内亚，在比塔帕卡战役中击败一支德国分遣队。
te: Australia invades German New Guinea, defeating a German contingent at the Battle of Bita Paka.
dz: 第一次世界大战：澳大利亚入侵德属新几内亚，在比塔帕卡战役中击败一支德国分遣队。
de: World War I: Australia invades German New Guinea, defeating a German contingent at the Battle of Bita Paka.

t: HMAS AE1,是澳大利亚皇家海军的首艘潜艇,在巴布亚新几内亚东新不列颠附近全手出海.
te: HMAS AE1, the Royal Australian Navy's first submarine, is lost at sea with all hands near East New Britain, Papua New G…
dz: HMAS AE1,是澳大利亚皇家海军的首艘潜艇,在巴布亚新几内亚东新不列颠附近全手出海.
de: HMAS AE1, the Royal Australian Navy's first submarine, is lost at sea with all hands near East New Britain, Papua New Guinea.

t: 普热梅希尔（今波兰）围攻战开始。
te: The Siege of Przemyśl (present-day Poland) begins.
dz: 第一次世界大战：普热梅希尔（今波兰）围攻战开始。
de: World War I: The Siege of Przemyśl (present-day Poland) begins.

t: 第一次世界大战：海洋竞赛开始。
te: The Race to the Sea begins.
dz: 第一次世界大战：海洋竞赛开始。
de: World War I: The Race to the Sea begins.

t: 安德鲁·费舍尔第三次成为澳大利亚总理。
te: Andrew Fisher becomes Prime Minister of Australia for the third time.
dz: 安德鲁·费舍尔第三次成为澳大利亚总理。
de: Andrew Fisher becomes Prime Minister of Australia for the third time.

t: 爱尔兰"地方自治法"成为了法律,但被推迟到一战后.
te: The Irish Home Rule Act becomes law, but is delayed until after World War I.
dz: 爱尔兰"地方自治法"成为了法律,但被推迟到一战后.
de: The Irish Home Rule Act becomes law, but is delayed until after World War I.

t: 一艘德国潜艇在70分钟的时间内击沉了三艘英国巡洋舰,杀死了近1500名水手.
te: A German submarine sinks three British cruisers over a seventy-minute period, killing almost 1,500 sailors.
dz: 一艘德国潜艇在70分钟的时间内击沉了三艘英国巡洋舰,杀死了近1500名水手.
de: A German submarine sinks three British cruisers over a seventy-minute period, killing almost 1,500 sailors.

t: 美国联邦贸易委员会由"联邦贸易委员会法"所设立.
te: The United States Federal Trade Commission is established by the Federal Trade Commission Act.
dz: 美国联邦贸易委员会由"联邦贸易委员会法"所设立.
de: The United States Federal Trade Commission is established by the Federal Trade Commission Act.

t: 一架飞机首次成功用炮火摧毁另一架飞机。
te: An aircraft successfully destroys another aircraft with gunfire for the first time.
dz: 第一次世界大战：一架飞机首次成功用炮火摧毁另一架飞机。
de: World War I: An aircraft successfully destroys another aircraft with gunfire for the first time.

t: 第一次世界大战：安特卫普围城结束。
te: The Siege of Antwerp comes to an end.
dz: 第一次世界大战：安特卫普围城结束。
de: World War I: The Siege of Antwerp comes to an end.

t: Schoenstatt使徒运动在德国成立.
te: The Schoenstatt Apostolic Movement is founded in Germany.
dz: Schoenstatt使徒运动在德国成立.
de: The Schoenstatt Apostolic Movement is founded in Germany.

t: 第一次世界大战：第一次伊普尔战役开始。
te: The First Battle of Ypres begins.
dz: 第一次世界大战：第一次伊普尔战役开始。
de: World War I: The First Battle of Ypres begins.

t: 新的英国战列舰“大胆”号被德国武装商船柏林号布设的雷区击沉。
te: The new British battleship HMS Audacious is sunk by a minefield laid by the armed German merchant-cruiser Berlin.
dz: 第一次世界大战：新的英国战列舰“大胆”号被德国武装商船柏林号布设的雷区击沉。
de: World War I: The new British battleship HMS Audacious is sunk by a minefield laid by the armed German merchant-cruiser Berlin.

t: 奥斯曼帝国站在同盟国一边参战。
te: the Ottoman Empire enters the war on the side of the Central Powers.
dz: 第一次世界大战：奥斯曼帝国站在同盟国一边参战。
de: World War I :  the Ottoman Empire enters the war on the side of the Central Powers.

t: 澳大利亚帝国部队(AIF)由一船一船从西澳大利亚的奥尔巴尼出发去埃及.
te: The Australian Imperial Force (AIF) departed by ship in a single convoy from Albany, Western Australia bound for Egypt.
dz: 第一次世界大战:澳大利亚帝国部队(AIF)由一船一船从西澳大利亚的奥尔巴尼出发去埃及.
de: World War I: The Australian Imperial Force (AIF) departed by ship in a single convoy from Albany, Western Australia bound for Egypt.

t: 英国皇家海军在与德国的战争中第一次失败，即科罗内尔战役，发生在太平洋智利西海岸，损失了英国皇家…
te: The first British Royal Navy defeat of the war with Germany, the Battle of Coronel, is fought off of the western coast …
dz: 第一次世界大战：英国皇家海军在与德国的战争中第一次失败，即科罗内尔战役，发生在太平洋智利西海岸，损失了英国皇家海军好望号和英国皇家海军蒙茅斯号。
de: World War I: The first British Royal Navy defeat of the war with Germany, the Battle of Coronel, is fought off of the western coast of Chile, in the Pacific, with the loss of HMS Good Hope and HMS Monmouth.

t: 俄罗斯帝国向奥斯曼帝国宣战，达达尼尔海峡随后关闭。
te: The Russian Empire declares war on the Ottoman Empire and the Dardanelles is subsequently closed.
dz: 第一次世界大战：俄罗斯帝国向奥斯曼帝国宣战，达达尼尔海峡随后关闭。
de: World War I: The Russian Empire declares war on the Ottoman Empire and the Dardanelles is subsequently closed.

t: 法国和大英帝国向奥斯曼帝国宣战。
te: France and the British Empire declare war on the Ottoman Empire.
dz: 第一次世界大战：法国和大英帝国向奥斯曼帝国宣战。
de: World War I: France and the British Empire declare war on the Ottoman Empire.

t: 德国殖民地胶州湾及其中心青岛被日军占领。这使得德国失去了远东基地。
te: The German colony of Kiaochow Bay and its centre at Tsingtao are captured by Japanese forces. This leaves Germany witho…
dz: 德国殖民地胶州湾及其中心青岛被日军占领。这使得德国失去了远东基地。
de: The German colony of Kiaochow Bay and its centre at Tsingtao are captured by Japanese forces. This leaves Germany without a far east base.

t: 简讯 Emden被HMAS Sydney 在可可斯战役中被击沉.
te: SMS Emden is sunk by HMAS Sydney in the Battle of Cocos.
dz: 简讯 Emden被HMAS Sydney 在可可斯战役中被击沉.
de: SMS Emden is sunk by HMAS Sydney in the Battle of Cocos.

t: 柏柏尔部落人在埃尔赫里战役中使法军在摩洛哥的惨败最惨重.
te: Berber tribesmen inflict the heaviest defeat of French forces in Morocco at the Battle of El Herri.
dz: 扎安会战:柏柏尔部落人在埃尔赫里战役中使法军在摩洛哥的惨败最惨重.
de: Zaian War: Berber tribesmen inflict the heaviest defeat of French forces in Morocco at the Battle of El Herri.

t: 由Eliel Saarinen设计的约恩苏市政厅在芬兰约恩苏落成.
te: The Joensuu City Hall, designed by Eliel Saarinen, was inaugurated in Joensuu, Finland.
dz: 由Eliel Saarinen设计的约恩苏市政厅在芬兰约恩苏落成.
de: The Joensuu City Hall, designed by Eliel Saarinen, was inaugurated in Joensuu, Finland.

t: 美国联邦储备银行正式开行.
te: The Federal Reserve Bank of the United States officially opens.
dz: 美国联邦储备银行正式开行.
de: The Federal Reserve Bank of the United States officially opens.

t: 最后一支美军从七个月前因坦皮科事件而占领的韦拉克鲁斯撤出。
te: The last of U.S. forces withdraw from Veracruz, occupied seven months earlier in response to the Tampico Affair.
dz: 墨西哥革命：最后一支美军从七个月前因坦皮科事件而占领的韦拉克鲁斯撤出。
de: Mexican Revolution: The last of U.S. forces withdraw from Veracruz, occupied seven months earlier in response to the Tampico Affair.

t: HMS Bulwark被一场大规模的内爆所摧毁,在希内斯附近锚地时损失了741人.
te: HMS Bulwark is destroyed by a large internal explosion with the loss of 741 men while at anchor near Sheerness.
dz: HMS Bulwark被一场大规模的内爆所摧毁,在希内斯附近锚地时损失了741人.
de: HMS Bulwark is destroyed by a large internal explosion with the loss of 741 men while at anchor near Sheerness.

t: 继 7 月份因战争而关闭之后，纽约证券交易所重新开放进行债券交易。
te: Following a war-induced closure in July, the New York Stock Exchange re-opens for bond trading.
dz: 第一次世界大战：继 7 月份因战争而关闭之后，纽约证券交易所重新开放进行债券交易。
de: World War I: Following a war-induced closure in July, the New York Stock Exchange re-opens for bond trading.

t: 帝国横贯南极探险队开始尝试首次陆地穿越南极洲。
te: The Imperial Trans-Antarctic Expedition begins in an attempt to make the first land crossing of Antarctica.
dz: 帝国横贯南极探险队开始尝试首次陆地穿越南极洲。
de: The Imperial Trans-Antarctic Expedition begins in an attempt to make the first land crossing of Antarctica.

t: 英国皇家海军的一个中队在南大西洋的福克兰群岛海战中击败了德意志帝国东亚分舰队。
te: A squadron of Britain's Royal Navy defeats the Imperial German East Asia Squadron in the Battle of the Falkland Islands…
dz: 第一次世界大战：英国皇家海军的一个中队在南大西洋的福克兰群岛海战中击败了德意志帝国东亚分舰队。
de: World War I: A squadron of Britain's Royal Navy defeats the Imperial German East Asia Squadron in the Battle of the Falkland Islands in the South Atlantic.

t: Lisandro de la Torre等在阿根廷布宜诺斯艾利斯萨伏依酒店发现了民主进步党(P…
te: Lisandro de la Torre and others found the Democratic Progressive Party (Partido Demócrata Progresista, PDP) at the Hote…
dz: Lisandro de la Torre等在阿根廷布宜诺斯艾利斯萨伏依酒店发现了民主进步党(Partido Demócrata Progresista,PDP).
de: Lisandro de la Torre and others found the Democratic Progressive Party (Partido Demócrata Progresista, PDP) at the Hotel Savoy, Buenos Aires, Argentina.

t: 日本九州三菱亨杰煤矿发生瓦斯爆炸,造成687人死亡.
te: A gas explosion at Mitsubishi Hōjō coal mine, in Kyushu, Japan, kills 687.
dz: 日本九州三菱亨杰煤矿发生瓦斯爆炸,造成687人死亡.
de: A gas explosion at Mitsubishi Hōjō coal mine, in Kyushu, Japan, kills 687.

t: 塞尔维亚军队从入侵的奥匈帝国军队手中夺回贝尔格莱德。
te: The Serbian Army recaptures Belgrade from the invading Austro-Hungarian Army.
dz: 第一次世界大战：塞尔维亚军队从入侵的奥匈帝国军队手中夺回贝尔格莱德。
de: World War I: The Serbian Army recaptures Belgrade from the invading Austro-Hungarian Army.

t: 弗朗兹·冯·希佩尔海军上将指挥对斯卡伯勒、哈特尔普尔和惠特比进行突袭。
te: Admiral Franz von Hipper commands a raid on Scarborough, Hartlepool and Whitby.
dz: 第一次世界大战：弗朗兹·冯·希佩尔海军上将指挥对斯卡伯勒、哈特尔普尔和惠特比进行突袭。
de: World War I: Admiral Franz von Hipper commands a raid on Scarborough, Hartlepool and Whitby.

t: 萨勒卡米什战役期间，奥斯曼军队互相误认为俄罗斯军队。接下来的误伤事件导致 2,000 名奥斯曼…
te: During the Battle of Sarikamish, Ottoman forces mistook one another for Russian troops. The following friendly fire inc…
dz: 第一次世界大战：萨勒卡米什战役期间，奥斯曼军队互相误认为俄罗斯军队。接下来的误伤事件导致 2,000 名奥斯曼人死亡，多人受伤。
de: World War I: During the Battle of Sarikamish, Ottoman forces mistook one another for Russian troops. The following friendly fire incident leaves 2,000 Ottomans dead and many more wounded.

t: 澳大利亚和新西兰军队抵达埃及开罗。
te: Australian and New Zealand troops arrive in Cairo, Egypt.
dz: 第一次世界大战：澳大利亚和新西兰军队抵达埃及开罗。
de: World War I: Australian and New Zealand troops arrive in Cairo, Egypt.

t: 第一次世界大战：“圣诞休战”开始。
te: The "Christmas truce" begins.
dz: 第一次世界大战：“圣诞休战”开始。
de: World War I: The "Christmas truce" begins.

t: 西线各地发生一系列非正式休战以庆祝圣诞节。
te: A series of unofficial truces occur across the Western Front to celebrate Christmas.
dz: 第一次世界大战：西线各地发生一系列非正式休战以庆祝圣诞节。
de: World War I: A series of unofficial truces occur across the Western Front to celebrate Christmas.
